title: Savior When in Dust to Thee
description: Savior When in Dust to Thee in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 5 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Robert Grant, first published in 1815. The tune, ABERYSTWYTH (PARRY), is by Joseph Parry (1879). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: Sa-vior,_ when_ in dust to Thee Low we bow th'a-dor_-ing knee, When, re_-pent_-ant, to the skies Scarce we_ lift our weep-ing eyes, O by all the pains and_ woes Suff-ered once for man be_-low, Bend-ing from Thy throne on high, Hear our_ pen_-i-ten-tial cry!

lines: Savior, when in dust to Thee
Scarce we lift our weeping eyes,
O by all the pains and woes
Bending from Thy throne on high,
By Thy life of want and tears,
By Thy days of sore distress
Turn, O turn a fav'ring eye,
By the sacred griefs that wept
O'er the grave where Laz'rus slept,
By the boding tears that flowed
By the anguished sigh that told
From Thy seat above the sky,
By Thine hour of dire despair,
By the cross, the nail, the thorn,
By the gloom that veiled the skies
By the vault whose dark abode
Held in vain the rising God,
O from earth to heaven restored,
